I added the `/` shortcut. Enter-to-add and Escape-to-cancel already worked, so I left them as they were. Both logic checks pass, and the page script has no syntax errors. I did not test the shortcuts in a browser. Nothing else from the earlier batches is broken.

`/` focuses search unless the cursor is in a text field, dropdown or editable area. On a checkbox or button it still works, and it does nothing when Ctrl, Cmd or Alt is held.

Batch 06 deleted the coloured priority borders, but items still carry their priority level. I left that as is, since it looks like it was asked for.
